witplayer

支持 MP4/M3U8/直播 · 移动端自适应

🎬 MP4 📡 HLS/M3U8 🔴 直播 📱 移动端适配

📝 使用方法

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <script src="./witplayer.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
  <div id="player"></div>
  
  <script>
  // MP4 视频
  const player = new witplayer({
    container: '#player',
    src: 'video.mp4'
  });

  // HLS/M3U8 视频
  const player = new witplayer({
    container: '#player',
    src: 'video.m3u8',
    isM3u8: true
  });

  // HLS 直播
  const player = new witplayer({
    container: '#player',
    src: 'live.m3u8',
    isM3u8: true,
    isLive: true
  });

  // API 方法
  player.play();
  player.pause();
  player.stop();
  player.seek(30);
  player.setVolume(0.5);
  player.destroy();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
